_provenance.how: scan the whole chain in 4999-block chunks for PairCreated topic0 and inspect the raw log objects, then re-extract the pair address two ways
_provenance.proves: that on this chain PairCreated is emitted with THREE topics: token0 and token1 indexed, the pair address in data word 0 and the pair index in data word 1, even though the signature declares the pair as indexed
_provenance.does_not_prove: which declaration a given factory implements - the shape is per-deployment and a parser has to read it rather than assume it

bug_it_caught: extracting the pair from data word 2 (the index word) instead of word 0 returned 1030 addresses of the form 0x0000...00NN, which made every dual-venue pair disappear. The census was re-run after the fix; the pre-fix output is not recorded as evidence
